name: Project Delta
desc:
Survive in a post-apocalyptic world following a catastrophic nuclear power plant disaster. Scavenge for superior equipment and conquer the wastelands to become their ruler. Decide whether to work with your faction or betray it. The fate of your legacy is in your hands.

This game is a true test of your survival and PvP skills. Prepare to face challenges that will test your abilities to the fullest.

Experience the ultimate gaming immersion with state-of-the-art Roblox graphics, featuring full PBR materials.

Please be aware that this game is still in development and does not represent the final product. Expect frequent updates and occasional restarts. While your skins and delta currency will be retained, player inventories and non-permanent items may be reset with significant updates.

Special Credits:
We are inspired by the original Deadzone on Roblox and express our sincere appreciation to its creator for the incredible game idea that ignited our own creative journey.

scripts.features:
Sir Meme Hub: 17 games, one $14.99 payment for a lifetime licence. No ad links or recurring key resets. Updates included for as long as the hub runs.

Latest changelog: 19 October 2026, v2.10.1 beta.

RIVALS: Silent Aim, Ragebot, skins, shared loadouts, match automation, movement recorder, emotes, Sound ESP and viewmodel tools. Stat/profile spoofing is client side; spectator alerts work during duels.
Phantom Forces: Silent Aim, Auto Shoot, Backtracking, camo/attachment controls and tracers. Anti Aim/fake position can cause server despawns.
BloxStrike: Silent Aim, Wallbang, Backtrack, weapon/knife/glove skins and grenade trajectory. Semi patched: RakNet required. Tracers show your own shots only.
Dungeon Quest Reborn: Auto Play with random paths/dodging, lobby/start controls, Equip Best, Auto Stats, daily rewards and webhook stats. Auto Play waits while the hub window is open, then observes Arm Delay.
Slayers 2: Level/boss/NPC, dungeon and fishing farms, gear/loot automation, world ESP, spawn alerts and private-server joining.
Fisch: Auto cast/shake/reel/bait, fish/rarity selling filters and favourites protection. Casting/loading repaired; re-execute without rejoining. Rage reel falls back to Blatant after two rejected attempts.
Command An Army: Rage/Legit AFK and hover-over-NPC farming, army/match automation, Kill Aura, summons, rewards and troop ESP.
Grand Piece Online: Auto Level Farm, mob gathering, retreat controls, Fast Attacks/Auto M1 and fruit/NPC/sea monster ESP.
Guts & Blackpowder: Zombie aim, Kill Aura, melee reach and Zombie ESP. Shove Expander extends a shove you perform manually.
Cold War: Silent Aim, gun mods, player/vehicle/turret ESP, low graphics and no shadows. Force Penetration is local/best effort; fire rate may be server capped.
Emergency Response: Liberty County: Silent Aim, Hold Target, House Robbery Farm, Minigame Farm, weapon mods and Walk Speed.
Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5: Mission farming/aim, auto loot/best gear, mags/survival, Loot/Storage/Zombie ESP, HQ staff/upgrades/research/deliveries and viewmodel offset. Storage contents require opening it first.
Operation One: Silent Aim/Wallbang, gun mods, player/gadget ESP, chams/tracers, custom sounds and third person.
Project Delta: Player/AI aim, lead/drop compensation, loot/body/faction ESP, Easy Climb and night/thermal vision.
Football Fusion 3: QB aim redirects your manual pass; Auto Throw is separate. Kicker aim, catch/block/swat tools and ball/carrier prediction.
South Bronx: Card/chip/marshmallow/box farms, four teleport methods, waypoints and weapon/utility tools. Working after bypass repair; occasional crashes remain.
Blade Ball: Auto Parry/clash spam, local sword/ability cosmetics, rewards and ESP. Unowned cosmetics are visible only to you and grant no ownership. Ability parries may be unreliable; loading stops if bypass fails.

24 shared controls vary by game: aim curves/timing, player/skeleton ESP, chams, visible/behind-cover colours, filters/preview, 72 skyboxes, weather, lightning and camera/world settings.

A separate Windows executor is required and not included. Crypto only; no refunds. Third party scripts can result in bans.
